I am 84 years old now, and my small maize plot here in Mangochi is all I have with my family. If I get the FISP coupon this year like some of my neighbors, I will buy one bag of NPK and one bag of urea — but my plot is small, so I will stretch it and even share a little with my son's plot. I always put the cattle kraal manure I collect through the dry season, because I have done this since I was a young man and it helps the soil when the rains are poor. I am too old now to dig much myself, so my sons and grandchildren help me, and sometimes I give a little food or money to a neighbor's boy to help weed when the maize is knee-high.
